headline: Productivity Skills - AI-Powered Note-Taking &
short_description: Transform Claude into your AI-powered productivity partner. Note-taking skill creates an AI-navigable second brain    with conversational capture, intelligent search, and pattern recognition across all your work. Plain markdown,   local-first, works in Claude Code and Claude Desktop.
author: mcdow-webworks

sections.overview:
Productivity Skills turns Claude into an active partner in your personal knowledge management by enabling conversational note capture, intelligent search, and pattern recognition across your work. All notes are stored as plain markdown files locally, keeping your data portable and secure. Claude automatically surfaces connections between ideas, recognizes patterns over time, and provides insights from your accumulated knowledge. The skill works within Claude Code and maintains a simple, searchable second brain that persists across sessions, solving the problem of information scattered across projects and lost context between conversations.
Capture and retrieve project decisions, technical solutions, and implementation details across sessions
Search your notes naturally with AI understanding to find related ideas and previous discussions
Track product roadmap themes, user feedback patterns, and strategic direction over time
Document technical learnings and code solutions to reuse approaches in future projects
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mcdow-webworks/productivity-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Act as my AI-powered productivity partner. Help me organize my notes and tasks for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. I'll share [DATA] from my meetings, emails, and projects. Create a structured, searchable knowledge base with intelligent connections between ideas. Use plain markdown format and ensure it works in Claude Code and Claude Desktop.
```
